Bootstrap ensemble of the residual-kriging correction surface

Source: R/spatial_bias_reduction.R
bootstrap_correction.Rd

Resamples the points with replacement n times, re-krige each draw onto newdata, and summarise the ensemble. Duplicate coordinates from resampling are jittered slightly so the kriging system stays non-singular.

Usage

bootstrap_correction(
  points,
  newdata,
  resid = "resid",
  model,
  n = 199,
  aoa = NULL,
  aoa_thresh = 1,
  jitter = 1,
  seed = NULL,
  cores = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

points

An sf point layer carrying a residual column.

newdata

Prediction locations (sf points or a SpatRaster).

resid

Name of the residual column (default "resid").

model

A fitted variogram model.

n

Number of bootstrap resamples.

aoa

Area-of-applicability restricting where the correction is produced (a DI SpatRaster or polygon; see residual_krige). NULL predicts everywhere.

aoa_thresh

In-domain DI threshold for a raster aoa (default 1).

jitter

Metres of jitter applied to resampled points to break ties.

seed

Optional RNG seed. For cores > 1 an L'Ecuyer-CMRG stream is used so the forked resamples are reproducible.

cores

Worker processes for the resample loop, capped at n. Defaults to getOption("mc.cores", 1L) (serial unless you opt in). Uses mclapply, which forks on Unix-alikes and degrades to serial on Windows.

...

Passed to krige.

Value

newdata (or a SpatRaster) with the ensemble mean corr_mean and standard deviation corr_sd of the correction, restricted to aoa.
